title: Chard and Ricotta Cannelloni
blurb: Pasta tubes filled with wilted chard and creamy ricotta, baked in a simple tomato sauce.
steps: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Finely chop the shallots and garlic, then soften them in half the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat for about 3 minutes.
Roughly chop the chard, add it to the pan with a pinch of salt, and cook until wilted, about 4 minutes. Drain any excess liquid and let it cool slightly.
Mix the wilted chard with the ricotta, half the Parmesan, the nutmeg, and black pepper in a bowl.
Cut the pasta sheets into rectangles roughly 10 by 12 centimetres. Place a generous spoonful of the chard mixture along one short edge of each rectangle and roll up to form tubes.
Spread half the passata over the base of a baking dish. Arrange the filled cannelloni seam-side down in a single layer, then pour over the remaining passata.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil, scatter over the rest of the Parmesan, and bake for 35 minutes until the pasta is tender and the top is lightly golden.
